understand.downtown_text: Every economic figure on this site describes Bernalillo County as a whole, not Downtown Albuquerque. Downtown has not been defined as a measurable area, and no Downtown-specific measurement has been established.
understand.withheld_text: Dula publishes a figure only if the file it came from is recorded, with a checksum, in a provenance manifest. These county figures are in the model but fail that test in this build, so they are left out instead of being shown without a source.

signals.title: How Bernalillo County's farms sold, 2017 and 2022
signals.origin_means: carried from the Atlas, with its assessment intact
signals.question: How did food & agriculture sales per reporting operation change between 2017 and 2022, and what explains it?
signals.reading: TWO OBSERVATIONS ARE NOT A TREND and do not identify a cause. market value of ag products sold +72.7% with -22.8% farm operations, so +123.5% per reporting unit; direct-to-consumer sales +8.1% with -35.2% operations selling direct to consumers, so +66.9% per reporting unit; sales to retailers, institutions & food hubs (local/regional brand) +2211.2% with +119.0% operations selling to retailers, institutions & food hubs, so +955.1% per reporting unit. Dividing the value by the operations that reported it separates PARTICIPATION from TRANSACTION SIZE — more sellers selling less is a different condition from fewer sellers selling more, and the two call for different work. It does NOT separate price from quantity. A FIGURE PER REPORTING OPERATION IS AN AGGREGATE RATIO, NOT AN INDIVIDUAL OUTCOME. It is a total divided by a count. A fall in it is consistent with patterns in which no single operation's sales fell — for example if the operations that joined the channel are smaller than the ones already in it. The publisher reports no distribution for this measure, so which pattern produced the movement is unknown. These are NOMINAL dollars. No deflator has been applied, so a movement in this figure is not a movement in real production or in volume: part of any change is price, and the published value does not separate the two.
signals.would_advance: the value change separated into price and quantity, the distribution behind the per-operation averages, and a constraint named by a market participant. A movement in a reported value is not a diagnosis.
signals.source: USDA NASS, Census of Agriculture 2017 and 2022
caveats: (D) = withheld to avoid disclosing individual operations; (Z) = less than half the unit; (NA) not available
Census counts operations by principal county of operation, not by where land lies
Census year 2022 data reflect calendar 2022 activity; 2022 was a severe drought year in northern NM
